criterion: Finding must identify the doc_free allocator double-free path, not a generic parser memory issue.
Names the affected location (src/yyjson.h: yyjson_doc_free() and src/yyjson.c: yyjson_mut_doc_free()) and traces the relevant attacker-controlled data or state to the unsafe operation.
Explains a technically plausible trigger or exploit path and does not rely on an unrelated generic weakness.
Describes the resulting security impact consistently with CWE-415 and the vulnerable code.
Recommends an effective remediation: Clear the document's allocator state before invoking allocator callbacks, preventing reentrant destruction from reusing the same state.
Produces one clear, source-cited finding with no unsupported claims or distracting false-positive findings.
